up: Retrieve the distinct preferred names (pref_name) of targets from the target_dictionary table for assays involving Plasmodium falciparum. Join the assays table and target_dictionary table on tid. sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid WHERE td.organism = 'Plasmodium falciparum' OR a.assay_organism = 'Plasmodium falciparum'
